Referral.title: Referral
Referral.description: A referral for a peer from a community microplanner to a facility.

peerName.description: The name or ID of the peer being referred.

referralId.description: The unique ID for the referral.

referralDate.description: The timestamp when the referral was created.

month.description: The month the referral was created (e.g., 'Jan', 'Feb').

linked.description: Whether the peer has been successfully linked to the facility.

linkageDate.description: The timestamp when the linkage was confirmed.
